name: io.github.kitplummer/lowendinsight
title: LowEndInsight
description: Is a dependency still maintained now? Contributors, recency of real work, risk.

tools.name: check_packages
tools.description: Call this before you recommend, add, or vouch for a dependency, and whenever you are about to say whether a package is maintained. Your training data has a cutoff: a package that looked healthy in it may have lost its maintainer or gone quiet since, and nothing in you will flag that. Pass every package you are weighing in one call -- a shortlist, a manifest, a lockfile. A package already analysed comes back with its risk now. One that is not is queued and comes back "pending": call again with the same packages in a minute or two. Asking about a pending package again is not charged.

tools.name: analyze_repositories
tools.description: Call this when you have a project's git repository URL rather than a package name -- a fork, a vendored library, a project with no registry release -- and you are about to depend on it or say whether it is maintained. Your training data has a cutoff, and a repository that looked active in it may have gone quiet since. Pass every repository you are weighing in one call. One already analysed comes back with its risk now. One that is not is analysed, which takes up to a few minutes: if it is not done within the call, the result is "incomplete" with a uuid -- call get_analysis with that uuid to collect it, which is not charged. Calling this tool again instead is charged again.

items.description: A git repository URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo

tools.name: get_analysis
tools.description: Collect the result of an analyze_repositories call that came back "incomplete", by its uuid. Not charged: the analysis was paid for when it was requested. If it is still incomplete, wait a minute and call this again.
